dataSource: items.ocp (OMNICELL-CONTENT v3, client 18.8.50_EP1) via tools/mp-weapon-extractor/Program.cs; every id/name verified against itemnames.sql at extraction time

definition.pool: Items whose ToWield carries a weapon-skill requirement, that are NOT profession-locked to a profession other than Bureaucrat, whose primary wield skill is one of [Pistol, MartialArts, MGSMG, Shotgun, 1hBlunt, RangedEnergy, MeleeEnergy], and that are placed in a HAND slot (Stat.Slot bit for EquipSlot.Weap_RightHand or Weap_LeftHand).
definition.handSlotRule: The hand-slot test is what separates weapons from items that merely carry a weapon-skill ToWield requirement. Without it the Legacy of the Xan '<skill> Skill NCU (n/6)' chips (Deck slots 1-6, no attack table, zero damage) are emitted as weapons - that was the bug in the previous generator, and their LoX expansion bit then mislabelled them as Xan weapons.
definition.endgameTiers: TL7 = ToWield TitleLevel >= 7 (level 205+). TL6 = ToWield TitleLevel = 6 (level 190+). expansion = no TitleLevel gate but top QL >= 200, max damage >= 300 and an Expansion(389) gate. high-rk = the same QL/damage floor with no expansion gate.
definition.endgameThresholdIsAJudgement: TitleLevel is read straight from the item and is authoritative. The 'QL >= 200 AND max damage >= 300' floor for the lower two tiers is a THRESHOLD CHOSEN FOR THIS FILE, not a fact from the data: QL alone does not separate endgame gear from ordinary shop weapons, which also span QL 1-200. Tune it here if you disagree.
definition.dedup: One row per MODEL (grouped by name). qlRange gives the model's span in items.ocp; every requirement, damage and gate figure is read at the model's TOP QL (statsReadAtQl) because those scale with QL.
definition.lineClassification: By item NAME against verified name sets (Xan / Beast / Ofab / Kyr'Ozch / Perennium / Dreadloch / other). Deliberately NOT by expansion bit - the expansion bit means 'you need this expansion to wield it', not 'this is that expansion's weapon line', and using it as a line classifier is what produced the bad Xan labels before.
definition.exclusions: NPC/monster-only templates (name matches '- Monster', 'monster only', 'Monster Version'), templates with no row in itemnames.sql, and GM/test/vehicle templates caught by four measured filters: a QL range topping out above 300 (no player item in AO exceeds QL 300, so these are monster/innate weapon templates); max damage >= 1000 (no verified player weapon line in this data exceeds 750, and the best ordinary shop weapons ~950); primary wield requirement > 2600 (the highest legitimate requirement in the file is 2500, Gan'Kar Rifle QL300); and QL >= 200 with a primary requirement under 100 (a QL300 template whose requirement never scaled). All are listed with their reason in _unverified.excludedModels.

sourceCoverage.note: 'Specific' means the row carries a cited acquisition (mob/playfield/tradeskill steps) from the sources listed in _sources. 'unknown' rows say so in their source text; no drop location is approximated.

weapons.name: Corrupted Lord of Lust
weapons.source: Pyramid of Home / "Dark Pyramid Below" (6-man, level 201-220). A DIRECT DROP - not a tradeskill step above 'X of the Xan'. The Corrupted weapons are a parallel endgame drop line, added in patch 18.8.6 (27 Oct 2015). They drop from the bosses of Pyramid of Home, a 6-man level 201-220 dungeon: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, then Phobettor. Portals last 4 hours (18.8.7). Entrance: the giant crater north of the city of Home on Rubi-Ka; since 18.8.6 you enter through the large door behind Number Nine inside the Temple of Home, Broken Shores. Access needs ONE of: any Profession Nanodeck worn (Dust Brigade quest base version or the Xan-upgraded one), the quest 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. The guide reports it also worked with just a Beast profession star worn. Patch 18.8.8 (9 Nov 2015) confirms what these are: the duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry was renamed and modified into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, and the Achaean Conqueror was added to drop alongside the other Corrupted weapons. That is why the client data shows them as QL 300 Legacy-of-the-Xan-gated weapons with the same flavour text as the 'X of the Xan' items but different damage and a title level 7 (level 205+) gate instead of title level 6. The Wisdom versions come in Atrox and non-Atrox and right/left-hand variants, adjusted with a screwdriver to match breed. No per-boss drop rates are published. NOTE: A claim that Corrupted weapons can be fed to a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device circulates online but traces only to a source outside the allowed list, and the 18.8.8 rename note argues against it. NOT recorded as fact.

weapons.name: Lust of the Xan
weapons.source: Legacy of the Xan team instances (device) + Pandemonium (base weapon). Xan Weapon Upgrade Device + <base weapon QL 299/300> = <X> of the Xan. No tradeskill skill required. The Xan Weapon Upgrade Device is QL 300, NODROP/Unique and is consumed by the combine. It drops in the three Legacy of the Xan team instances entered from floor portals in the Central Hub playfield: The Alien Threat / 'Mitaar Hero' (portal at 350 x 410, boss Technomaster Sinuh), LoX: Ground Chief Vortexx (portal at 523 x 307), and The Xan 12-man (portal at 419 x 324, final boss Deranged Xan). Since patch 18.3 none of them need the old prerequisite quests. No drop rate is published. The combine itself needs NO tradeskill skill. Base weapon for most sins is the matching Lord/Lady of <sin> from The Beast in Pandemonium. Dawn of the Xan and Dusk of the Xan take Sword of Dawn / Sword of Dusk instead (see those entries). Angst of the Xan additionally accepts High Lord of Angst; Anger/Envy/Angst of the Xan additionally accept the matching Superior Rebuilt Perennium weapon.

weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Pistol - Type 1
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump). Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets. Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n>. The Structural Analyzer is either Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool (reusable) + Kyr'Ozch Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool (consumed; a common Hacker'Uri drop) at 600 Quantum FT, or the reward for Uncle Bazzit's AI Perk 3 quest. Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared. Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published. Type -> specials: 1 Fling Shot; 2 Aimed Shot; 3 Fling+Aimed; 4 Burst; 5 Fling+Burst; 12 Burst+Full Auto; 13 Fling+Burst+Full Auto; 48 Brawl+Dimach; 76 Brawl+Fast Attack; 112 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack; 240 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack; 880 Dimach+Fast Attack+Parry+Riposte; 992 Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack+Parry+Riposte.

weapons.name: Dreadloch Balanced Freedom Arms
weapons.source: Dreadloch camps (Lost Eden), level 210-220. Dreadloch weapons are a DIRECT DROP from the Dreadloch camp bosses, not a tradeskill. They are QL300 only and require the Lost Eden expansion to wield (from the item's own Expansion(389) criterion). There are two sets of five camps, one per side. Omni-side camps (the CLAN quest chain, started by Captain Cante Hawke in Old Athens): Clondyke - Force Recon Commander 191; Eastern Foul Plains - Special Agent Moxy; Pleasant Meadows - Major Woon; Southern Artery Valley - Assault Commander Pax; Upper Stret East Bank - Peal Thunder. Clan-side camps (the OMNI quest chain, started by Paolo Turin near the Grid terminal in Omni-1 Trade 409x542, who sends you to Sergeant Jasmine Cordell in Omni-1 Entertainment 906x629): Belial Forest 3184x503 - Brigadier Crux; Athen Shire / War Academy 1720x1920 - Assault Commander Sleek; The Longest Road / Drumdar 3650x574 - Chief Gunner Kyle Swan; Broken Shores 2240x4765 - Special Agent Deko; Upper Stret East Bank / Safe Haventown 1798.6x2207.0 - Carillion Thunder. The bosses have a 2-hour respawn and the corpse can be looted for 29 minutes before it rots. The quest is NOT required to claim the loot - completing it adds a merit token worth +50 side tokens and +500 Victory Points. The same bosses also drop high-quality Kyr'Ozch clumps for Ofab upgrades, Hellfyre Magma Suit armour, the merit/combat board bases and the Dreadloch utility items (Damage Amplifier, Endurance Booster, Sniper's Friend, Stab Guidance System, Survival Predictor). No per-weapon drop rate is published on either allowed source. NOTE: Dreadloch weapons are NODROP. Which boss drops which weapon is not published: both guides list the weapon set per camp-chain, not per boss.

weapons.name: Ofab Peregrine Mk 6
weapons.source: Tower shop for Victory Points, then five Bio-Material upgrades. Buy the base Ofab Peregrine Mk 1 from the tower shop with Victory Points. Victory Points come from killing aliens on the Mothership or from Battlestation PvP. Upgrade it five times with Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type 812 (any QL), which drops from the boss on the alien Mothership. Mk1 -> Mk2 -> ... -> Mk6; Mk 6 is the maximum. ao-universe's Engineer guide calls the Ofab Peregrine Mk 6 the best pistol in the game for an Engineer with Lost Eden, and notes it can be dual-wielded even at QL300. NOTE: The Peregrine is the PISTOL Ofab line - the one an Engineer wants. Other Ofab models map to other professions weapon skills.

weapons.name: Corrupted Lady of Wisdom
weapons.source: Pyramid of Home / "Dark Pyramid Below" (6-man, level 201-220). A DIRECT DROP - not a tradeskill step above 'X of the Xan'. The Corrupted weapons are a parallel endgame drop line, added in patch 18.8.6 (27 Oct 2015). They drop from the bosses of Pyramid of Home, a 6-man level 201-220 dungeon: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, then Phobettor. Portals last 4 hours (18.8.7). Entrance: the giant crater north of the city of Home on Rubi-Ka; since 18.8.6 you enter through the large door behind Number Nine inside the Temple of Home, Broken Shores. Access needs ONE of: any Profession Nanodeck worn (Dust Brigade quest base version or the Xan-upgraded one), the quest 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. The guide reports it also worked with just a Beast profession star worn. Patch 18.8.8 (9 Nov 2015) confirms what these are: the duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry was renamed and modified into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, and the Achaean Conqueror was added to drop alongside the other Corrupted weapons. That is why the client data shows them as QL 300 Legacy-of-the-Xan-gated weapons with the same flavour text as the 'X of the Xan' items but different damage and a title level 7 (level 205+) gate instead of title level 6. The Wisdom versions come in Atrox and non-Atrox and right/left-hand variants, adjusted with a screwdriver to match breed. No per-boss drop rates are published. NOTE: A claim that Corrupted weapons can be fed to a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device circulates online but traces only to a source outside the allowed list, and the 18.8.8 rename note argues against it. NOT recorded as fact.

weapons.name: Dreadloch Shen Sticks
weapons.source: Dreadloch camps (Lost Eden), level 210-220. Dreadloch weapons are a DIRECT DROP from the Dreadloch camp bosses, not a tradeskill. They are QL300 only and require the Lost Eden expansion to wield (from the item's own Expansion(389) criterion). There are two sets of five camps, one per side. Omni-side camps (the CLAN quest chain, started by Captain Cante Hawke in Old Athens): Clondyke - Force Recon Commander 191; Eastern Foul Plains - Special Agent Moxy; Pleasant Meadows - Major Woon; Southern Artery Valley - Assault Commander Pax; Upper Stret East Bank - Peal Thunder. Clan-side camps (the OMNI quest chain, started by Paolo Turin near the Grid terminal in Omni-1 Trade 409x542, who sends you to Sergeant Jasmine Cordell in Omni-1 Entertainment 906x629): Belial Forest 3184x503 - Brigadier Crux; Athen Shire / War Academy 1720x1920 - Assault Commander Sleek; The Longest Road / Drumdar 3650x574 - Chief Gunner Kyle Swan; Broken Shores 2240x4765 - Special Agent Deko; Upper Stret East Bank / Safe Haventown 1798.6x2207.0 - Carillion Thunder. The bosses have a 2-hour respawn and the corpse can be looted for 29 minutes before it rots. The quest is NOT required to claim the loot - completing it adds a merit token worth +50 side tokens and +500 Victory Points. The same bosses also drop high-quality Kyr'Ozch clumps for Ofab upgrades, Hellfyre Magma Suit armour, the merit/combat board bases and the Dreadloch utility items (Damage Amplifier, Endurance Booster, Sniper's Friend, Stab Guidance System, Survival Predictor). No per-weapon drop rate is published on either allowed source. NOTE: Dreadloch weapons are NODROP. Which boss drops which weapon is not published: both guides list the weapon set per camp-chain, not per boss.

weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Nunchacko
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership. Untyped Kyr'Ozch weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership; ao-universe and wiki.aodb.us give no per-mob table and no drop rates. An untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon has no special attacks until it is typed with a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> clump (see the '- Type' entries). NOTE: The wiki's Kyr'Ozch weapons section is empty and the Alien Loot page carries no mob/zone/rate attribution, so the exact drop source per weapon is unknown.

weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Nunchacko - Type 48
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump). Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets. Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n>. The Structural Analyzer is either Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool (reusable) + Kyr'Ozch Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool (consumed; a common Hacker'Uri drop) at 600 Quantum FT, or the reward for Uncle Bazzit's AI Perk 3 quest. Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared. Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published. Type -> specials: 1 Fling Shot; 2 Aimed Shot; 3 Fling+Aimed; 4 Burst; 5 Fling+Burst; 12 Burst+Full Auto; 13 Fling+Burst+Full Auto; 48 Brawl+Dimach; 76 Brawl+Fast Attack; 112 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack; 240 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack; 880 Dimach+Fast Attack+Parry+Riposte; 992 Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack+Parry+Riposte.

weapons.name: Corrupted Lord of Envy
weapons.source: Pyramid of Home / "Dark Pyramid Below" (6-man, level 201-220). A DIRECT DROP - not a tradeskill step above 'X of the Xan'. The Corrupted weapons are a parallel endgame drop line, added in patch 18.8.6 (27 Oct 2015). They drop from the bosses of Pyramid of Home, a 6-man level 201-220 dungeon: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, then Phobettor. Portals last 4 hours (18.8.7). Entrance: the giant crater north of the city of Home on Rubi-Ka; since 18.8.6 you enter through the large door behind Number Nine inside the Temple of Home, Broken Shores. Access needs ONE of: any Profession Nanodeck worn (Dust Brigade quest base version or the Xan-upgraded one), the quest 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. The guide reports it also worked with just a Beast profession star worn. Patch 18.8.8 (9 Nov 2015) confirms what these are: the duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry was renamed and modified into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, and the Achaean Conqueror was added to drop alongside the other Corrupted weapons. That is why the client data shows them as QL 300 Legacy-of-the-Xan-gated weapons with the same flavour text as the 'X of the Xan' items but different damage and a title level 7 (level 205+) gate instead of title level 6. The Wisdom versions come in Atrox and non-Atrox and right/left-hand variants, adjusted with a screwdriver to match breed. No per-boss drop rates are published. NOTE: A claim that Corrupted weapons can be fed to a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device circulates online but traces only to a source outside the allowed list, and the 18.8.8 rename note argues against it. NOT recorded as fact.

weapons.name: Envy of the Xan
weapons.source: Legacy of the Xan team instances (device) + Pandemonium (base weapon). Xan Weapon Upgrade Device + <base weapon QL 299/300> = <X> of the Xan. No tradeskill skill required. The Xan Weapon Upgrade Device is QL 300, NODROP/Unique and is consumed by the combine. It drops in the three Legacy of the Xan team instances entered from floor portals in the Central Hub playfield: The Alien Threat / 'Mitaar Hero' (portal at 350 x 410, boss Technomaster Sinuh), LoX: Ground Chief Vortexx (portal at 523 x 307), and The Xan 12-man (portal at 419 x 324, final boss Deranged Xan). Since patch 18.3 none of them need the old prerequisite quests. No drop rate is published. The combine itself needs NO tradeskill skill. Base weapon for most sins is the matching Lord/Lady of <sin> from The Beast in Pandemonium. Dawn of the Xan and Dusk of the Xan take Sword of Dawn / Sword of Dusk instead (see those entries). Angst of the Xan additionally accepts High Lord of Angst; Anger/Envy/Angst of the Xan additionally accept the matching Superior Rebuilt Perennium weapon.

weapons.name: Rhat'Ata Gun
weapons.source: Shop components + an existing Xan weapon. Modified Xan Weapons are made from a finished 'X of the Xan' weapon plus one shop-bought component. No tradeskill skill is required; the component must be QL 150 or higher and is consumed. Gluttony of the Xan + Notum Enriched Nano Paste - 16x Layer = Bhan'Zor Hammer Abandonment of the Xan + Notum Enriched Nano Paste - 16x Layer = Kur'Ush Mallet Lust of the Xan + Nano Pylon = Peh'Wer Pistol Peh'Wer Pistol + Runtime Critical Area Analyzer = Troa'Ler Pistol Envy of the Xan + Rapid-Reload-And-Fire Gyro = Rhat'Ata Gun  (MG/SMG - not usable by every profession) Angst of the Xan + Low-Light Targeting Scope = Gan'Kar Rifle  (Rifle - not usable by every profession) NOTE: The client data corroborates the chain: the description text on Peh'Wer Pistol reads 'The Lust of the Xan has been tweaked to a higher performance.'

weapons.name: Lady of Envy
weapons.source: The Beast, Pandemonium (Shadowlands). Drops from The Beast, the final boss of the Pandemonium raid (Shadowlands). No individual weapon drop rate is published.

weapons.name: Ofab Hawk Mk 6
weapons.source: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub. Bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points at the Ofab weapon terminals in the Unicorn Defence Hub (the 'Ofab Shop') in the Battle Station central area. VP is earned on Battlestations and on Lost Eden (Alien Mothership) missions. Terminals are bracketed by level: 10-30, 31-60, 61-100, 101-150, 151-200, 201-214, 215-220. Upgraded Mk 1 -> Mk 6 (five upgrades, strictly sequential) by adding a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clump to the weapon. No tradeskill skill is required; the clump must be at least 80% of the weapon's QL. Each upgrade also changes the weapon's appearance. Bio-Material by weapon: Type 34 for Ofab Panther (1h Blunt) and Ofab Bear (2h Blunt); Type 18 for Ofab Mongoose (1h Edged), Ofab Wolf (2h Edged) and Ofab Viper (Piercing); Type 812 for Ofab Peregrine (Pistol), Ofab Hawk (SMG) and Ofab Tiger (Bow); Type 687 for Ofab Cobra (Rifle), Ofab Shark (Assault Rifle) and Ofab Silverback (Shotgun). The clumps drop from the bosses in Lost Eden Alien Mothership missions (taken from the Unicorn Recruiter at the Unicorn Outpost in the Outerzones, via ICC) and from the Dreadloch bosses at the Clan and Omni camps. No VP price list is published; the only figure found is a player report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol. NOTE: ao-universe lists Type 812 as covering Bow; wiki.aodb.us lists it as Crossbow. Unresolved - both recorded in _unverified.

weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Submachine Gun
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership. Untyped Kyr'Ozch weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership; ao-universe and wiki.aodb.us give no per-mob table and no drop rates. An untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon has no special attacks until it is typed with a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> clump (see the '- Type' entries). NOTE: The wiki's Kyr'Ozch weapons section is empty and the Alien Loot page carries no mob/zone/rate attribution, so the exact drop source per weapon is unknown.

weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Submachine Gun - Type 12
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump). Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets. Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n>. The Structural Analyzer is either Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool (reusable) + Kyr'Ozch Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool (consumed; a common Hacker'Uri drop) at 600 Quantum FT, or the reward for Uncle Bazzit's AI Perk 3 quest. Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared. Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published. Type -> specials: 1 Fling Shot; 2 Aimed Shot; 3 Fling+Aimed; 4 Burst; 5 Fling+Burst; 12 Burst+Full Auto; 13 Fling+Burst+Full Auto; 48 Brawl+Dimach; 76 Brawl+Fast Attack; 112 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack; 240 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack; 880 Dimach+Fast Attack+Parry+Riposte; 992 Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack+Parry+Riposte.

weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Machine Pistol - Type 4
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump). Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets. Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n>. The Structural Analyzer is either Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool (reusable) + Kyr'Ozch Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool (consumed; a common Hacker'Uri drop) at 600 Quantum FT, or the reward for Uncle Bazzit's AI Perk 3 quest. Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared. Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published. weapons.name: Prototype Ofab Hawk
weapons.source: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub. Bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points at the Ofab weapon terminals in the Unicorn Defence Hub (the 'Ofab Shop') in the Battle Station central area. VP is earned on Battlestations and on Lost Eden (Alien Mothership) missions. Terminals are bracketed by level: 10-30, 31-60, 61-100, 101-150, 151-200, 201-214, 215-220. Upgraded Mk 1 -> Mk 6 (five upgrades, strictly sequential) by adding a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clump to the weapon. No tradeskill skill is required; the clump must be at least 80% of the weapon's QL. Each upgrade also changes the weapon's appearance. Bio-Material by weapon: Type 34 for Ofab Panther (1h Blunt) and Ofab Bear (2h Blunt); Type 18 for Ofab Mongoose (1h Edged), Ofab Wolf (2h Edged) and Ofab Viper (Piercing); Type 812 for Ofab Peregrine (Pistol), Ofab Hawk (SMG) and Ofab Tiger (Bow); Type 687 for Ofab Cobra (Rifle), Ofab Shark (Assault Rifle) and Ofab Silverback (Shotgun). The clumps drop from the bosses in Lost Eden Alien Mothership missions (taken from the Unicorn Recruiter at the Unicorn Outpost in the Outerzones, via ICC) and from the Dreadloch bosses at the Clan and Omni camps. No VP price list is published; the only figure found is a player report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol. NOTE: ao-universe lists Type 812 as covering Bow; wiki.aodb.us lists it as Crossbow. Unresolved - both recorded in _unverified.

weapons.name: Corrupted Lord of Greed
weapons.source: Pyramid of Home / "Dark Pyramid Below" (6-man, level 201-220). A DIRECT DROP - not a tradeskill step above 'X of the Xan'. The Corrupted weapons are a parallel endgame drop line, added in patch 18.8.6 (27 Oct 2015). They drop from the bosses of Pyramid of Home, a 6-man level 201-220 dungeon: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, then Phobettor. Portals last 4 hours (18.8.7). Entrance: the giant crater north of the city of Home on Rubi-Ka; since 18.8.6 you enter through the large door behind Number Nine inside the Temple of Home, Broken Shores. Access needs ONE of: any Profession Nanodeck worn (Dust Brigade quest base version or the Xan-upgraded one), the quest 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. The guide reports it also worked with just a Beast profession star worn. Patch 18.8.8 (9 Nov 2015) confirms what these are: the duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry was renamed and modified into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, and the Achaean Conqueror was added to drop alongside the other Corrupted weapons. That is why the client data shows them as QL 300 Legacy-of-the-Xan-gated weapons with the same flavour text as the 'X of the Xan' items but different damage and a title level 7 (level 205+) gate instead of title level 6. The Wisdom versions come in Atrox and non-Atrox and right/left-hand variants, adjusted with a screwdriver to match breed. No per-boss drop rates are published. NOTE: A claim that Corrupted weapons can be fed to a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device circulates online but traces only to a source outside the allowed list, and the 18.8.8 rename note argues against it. NOT recorded as fact.

weapons.name: Greed of the Xan
weapons.source: Legacy of the Xan team instances (device) + Pandemonium (base weapon). Xan Weapon Upgrade Device + <base weapon QL 299/300> = <X> of the Xan. No tradeskill skill required. The Xan Weapon Upgrade Device is QL 300, NODROP/Unique and is consumed by the combine. It drops in the three Legacy of the Xan team instances entered from floor portals in the Central Hub playfield: The Alien Threat / 'Mitaar Hero' (portal at 350 x 410, boss Technomaster Sinuh), LoX: Ground Chief Vortexx (portal at 523 x 307), and The Xan 12-man (portal at 419 x 324, final boss Deranged Xan). Since patch 18.3 none of them need the old prerequisite quests. No drop rate is published. The combine itself needs NO tradeskill skill. Base weapon for most sins is the matching Lord/Lady of <sin> from The Beast in Pandemonium. Dawn of the Xan and Dusk of the Xan take Sword of Dawn / Sword of Dusk instead (see those entries). Angst of the Xan additionally accepts High Lord of Angst; Anger/Envy/Angst of the Xan additionally accept the matching Superior Rebuilt Perennium weapon.

weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Shotgun - Type 1
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump). Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets. Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n>. The Structural Analyzer is either Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool (reusable) + Kyr'Ozch Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool (consumed; a common Hacker'Uri drop) at 600 Quantum FT, or the reward for Uncle Bazzit's AI Perk 3 quest. Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared. Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published. Type -> specials: 1 Fling Shot; 2 Aimed Shot; 3 Fling+Aimed; 4 Burst; 5 Fling+Burst; 12 Burst+Full Auto; 13 Fling+Burst+Full Auto; 48 Brawl+Dimach; 76 Brawl+Fast Attack; 112 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack; 240 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack; 880 Dimach+Fast Attack+Parry+Riposte; 992 Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack+Parry+Riposte.

Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published.

Type -> specials: 1 Fling Shot; 2 Aimed Shot; 3 Fling+Aimed; 4 Burst; 5 Fling+Burst; 12 Burst+Full Auto; 13 Fling+Burst+Full Auto; 48 Brawl+Dimach; 76 Brawl+Fast Attack; 112 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack; 240 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack; 880 Dimach+Fast Attack+Parry+Riposte; 992 Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack+Parry+Riposte.

weapons.name: Ofab Silverback Mk 2
weapons.source: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub. Bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points at the Ofab weapon terminals in the Unicorn Defence Hub (the 'Ofab Shop') in the Battle Station central area. VP is earned on Battlestations and on Lost Eden (Alien Mothership) missions. Terminals are bracketed by level: 10-30, 31-60, 61-100, 101-150, 151-200, 201-214, 215-220. Upgraded Mk 1 -> Mk 6 (five upgrades, strictly sequential) by adding a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clump to the weapon. No tradeskill skill is required; the clump must be at least 80% of the weapon's QL. Each upgrade also changes the weapon's appearance. Bio-Material by weapon: Type 34 for Ofab Panther (1h Blunt) and Ofab Bear (2h Blunt); Type 18 for Ofab Mongoose (1h Edged), Ofab Wolf (2h Edged) and Ofab Viper (Piercing); Type 812 for Ofab Peregrine (Pistol), Ofab Hawk (SMG) and Ofab Tiger (Bow); Type 687 for Ofab Cobra (Rifle), Ofab Shark (Assault Rifle) and Ofab Silverback (Shotgun). The clumps drop from the bosses in Lost Eden Alien Mothership missions (taken from the Unicorn Recruiter at the Unicorn Outpost in the Outerzones, via ICC) and from the Dreadloch bosses at the Clan and Omni camps. No VP price list is published; the only figure found is a player report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol. NOTE: ao-universe lists Type 812 as covering Bow; wiki.aodb.us lists it as Crossbow. weapons.name: Prototype Ofab Silverback
weapons.source: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub. Bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points at the Ofab weapon terminals in the Unicorn Defence Hub (the 'Ofab Shop') in the Battle Station central area. VP is earned on Battlestations and on Lost Eden (Alien Mothership) missions. Terminals are bracketed by level: 10-30, 31-60, 61-100, 101-150, 151-200, 201-214, 215-220. Upgraded Mk 1 -> Mk 6 (five upgrades, strictly sequential) by adding a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clump to the weapon. No tradeskill skill is required; the clump must be at least 80% of the weapon's QL. Each upgrade also changes the weapon's appearance. Bio-Material by weapon: Type 34 for Ofab Panther (1h Blunt) and Ofab Bear (2h Blunt); Type 18 for Ofab Mongoose (1h Edged), Ofab Wolf (2h Edged) and Ofab Viper (Piercing); Type 812 for Ofab Peregrine (Pistol), Ofab Hawk (SMG) and Ofab Tiger (Bow); Type 687 for Ofab Cobra (Rifle), Ofab Shark (Assault Rifle) and Ofab Silverback (Shotgun). The clumps drop from the bosses in Lost Eden Alien Mothership missions (taken from the Unicorn Recruiter at the Unicorn Outpost in the Outerzones, via ICC) and from the Dreadloch bosses at the Clan and Omni camps. No VP price list is published; the only figure found is a player report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol. NOTE: ao-universe lists Type 812 as covering Bow; wiki.aodb.us lists it as Crossbow. Unresolved - both recorded in _unverified.

weapons.name: Corrupted Lord of Abandonment
weapons.source: Pyramid of Home / "Dark Pyramid Below" (6-man, level 201-220). A DIRECT DROP - not a tradeskill step above 'X of the Xan'. The Corrupted weapons are a parallel endgame drop line, added in patch 18.8.6 (27 Oct 2015). They drop from the bosses of Pyramid of Home, a 6-man level 201-220 dungeon: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, then Phobettor. Portals last 4 hours (18.8.7). Entrance: the giant crater north of the city of Home on Rubi-Ka; since 18.8.6 you enter through the large door behind Number Nine inside the Temple of Home, Broken Shores. Access needs ONE of: any Profession Nanodeck worn (Dust Brigade quest base version or the Xan-upgraded one), the quest 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. The guide reports it also worked with just a Beast profession star worn. Patch 18.8.8 (9 Nov 2015) confirms what these are: the duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry was renamed and modified into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, and the Achaean Conqueror was added to drop alongside the other Corrupted weapons. That is why the client data shows them as QL 300 Legacy-of-the-Xan-gated weapons with the same flavour text as the 'X of the Xan' items but different damage and a title level 7 (level 205+) gate instead of title level 6. The Wisdom versions come in Atrox and non-Atrox and right/left-hand variants, adjusted with a screwdriver to match breed. No per-boss drop rates are published. NOTE: A claim that Corrupted weapons can be fed to a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device circulates online but traces only to a source outside the allowed list, and the 18.8.8 rename note argues against it. NOT recorded as fact.

weapons.name: Abandonment of the Xan
weapons.source: Legacy of the Xan team instances (device) + Pandemonium (base weapon). Xan Weapon Upgrade Device + <base weapon QL 299/300> = <X> of the Xan. No tradeskill skill required. The Xan Weapon Upgrade Device is QL 300, NODROP/Unique and is consumed by the combine. It drops in the three Legacy of the Xan team instances entered from floor portals in the Central Hub playfield: The Alien Threat / 'Mitaar Hero' (portal at 350 x 410, boss Technomaster Sinuh), LoX: Ground Chief Vortexx (portal at 523 x 307), and The Xan 12-man (portal at 419 x 324, final boss Deranged Xan). Since patch 18.3 none of them need the old prerequisite quests. No drop rate is published. The combine itself needs NO tradeskill skill. Base weapon for most sins is the matching Lord/Lady of <sin> from The Beast in Pandemonium. Dawn of the Xan and Dusk of the Xan take Sword of Dawn / Sword of Dusk instead (see those entries). Angst of the Xan additionally accepts High Lord of Angst; Anger/Envy/Angst of the Xan additionally accept the matching Superior Rebuilt Perennium weapon.

weapons.name: Dreadloch Enhanced Panther
weapons.source: Dreadloch camps (Lost Eden), level 210-220. Dreadloch weapons are a DIRECT DROP from the Dreadloch camp bosses, not a tradeskill. They are QL300 only and require the Lost Eden expansion to wield (from the item's own Expansion(389) criterion). There are two sets of five camps, one per side. Omni-side camps (the CLAN quest chain, started by Captain Cante Hawke in Old Athens): Clondyke - Force Recon Commander 191; Eastern Foul Plains - Special Agent Moxy; Pleasant Meadows - Major Woon; Southern Artery Valley - Assault Commander Pax; Upper Stret East Bank - Peal Thunder. Clan-side camps (the OMNI quest chain, started by Paolo Turin near the Grid terminal in Omni-1 Trade 409x542, who sends you to Sergeant Jasmine Cordell in Omni-1 Entertainment 906x629): Belial Forest 3184x503 - Brigadier Crux; Athen Shire / War Academy 1720x1920 - Assault Commander Sleek; The Longest Road / Drumdar 3650x574 - Chief Gunner Kyle Swan; Broken Shores 2240x4765 - Special Agent Deko; Upper Stret East Bank / Safe Haventown 1798.6x2207.0 - Carillion Thunder. The bosses have a 2-hour respawn and the corpse can be looted for 29 minutes before it rots. The quest is NOT required to claim the loot - completing it adds a merit token worth +50 side tokens and +500 Victory Points. The same bosses also drop high-quality Kyr'Ozch clumps for Ofab upgrades, Hellfyre Magma Suit armour, the merit/combat board bases and the Dreadloch utility items (Damage Amplifier, Endurance Booster, Sniper's Friend, Stab Guidance System, Survival Predictor). No per-weapon drop rate is published on either allowed source. NOTE: Dreadloch weapons are NODROP. Which boss drops which weapon is not published: both guides list the weapon set per camp-chain, not per boss.

weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Hammer - Type 112
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump). Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets. Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n>. The Structural Analyzer is either Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool (reusable) + Kyr'Ozch Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool (consumed; a common Hacker'Uri drop) at 600 Quantum FT, or the reward for Uncle Bazzit's AI Perk 3 quest. Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared. Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published. Type -> specials: 1 Fling Shot; 2 Aimed Shot; 3 Fling+Aimed; 4 Burst; 5 Fling+Burst; 12 Burst+Full Auto; 13 Fling+Burst+Full Auto; 48 Brawl+Dimach; 76 Brawl+Fast Attack; 112 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack; 240 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack; 880 Dimach+Fast Attack+Parry+Riposte; 992 Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack+Parry+Riposte.

weapons.name: Ofab Panther Mk 2
weapons.source: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub. Bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points at the Ofab weapon terminals in the Unicorn Defence Hub (the 'Ofab Shop') in the Battle Station central area. VP is earned on Battlestations and on Lost Eden (Alien Mothership) missions. Terminals are bracketed by level: 10-30, 31-60, 61-100, 101-150, 151-200, 201-214, 215-220. Upgraded Mk 1 -> Mk 6 (five upgrades, strictly sequential) by adding a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clump to the weapon. No tradeskill skill is required; the clump must be at least 80% of the weapon's QL. Each upgrade also changes the weapon's appearance. Bio-Material by weapon: Type 34 for Ofab Panther (1h Blunt) and Ofab Bear (2h Blunt); Type 18 for Ofab Mongoose (1h Edged), Ofab Wolf (2h Edged) and Ofab Viper (Piercing); Type 812 for Ofab Peregrine (Pistol), Ofab Hawk (SMG) and Ofab Tiger (Bow); Type 687 for Ofab Cobra (Rifle), Ofab Shark (Assault Rifle) and Ofab Silverback (Shotgun). The clumps drop from the bosses in Lost Eden Alien Mothership missions (taken from the Unicorn Recruiter at the Unicorn Outpost in the Outerzones, via ICC) and from the Dreadloch bosses at the Clan and Omni camps. No VP price list is published; the only figure found is a player report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol. NOTE: ao-universe lists Type 812 as covering Bow; wiki.aodb.us lists it as Crossbow. Unresolved - both recorded in _unverified.

weapons.name: Prototype Ofab Panther
weapons.source: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub. Bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points at the Ofab weapon terminals in the Unicorn Defence Hub (the 'Ofab Shop') in the Battle Station central area. VP is earned on Battlestations and on Lost Eden (Alien Mothership) missions. Terminals are bracketed by level: 10-30, 31-60, 61-100, 101-150, 151-200, 201-214, 215-220. Upgraded Mk 1 -> Mk 6 (five upgrades, strictly sequential) by adding a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clump to the weapon. No tradeskill skill is required; the clump must be at least 80% of the weapon's QL. Each upgrade also changes the weapon's appearance. Bio-Material by weapon: Type 34 for Ofab Panther (1h Blunt) and Ofab Bear (2h Blunt); Type 18 for Ofab Mongoose (1h Edged), Ofab Wolf (2h Edged) and Ofab Viper (Piercing); Type 812 for Ofab Peregrine (Pistol), Ofab Hawk (SMG) and Ofab Tiger (Bow); Type 687 for Ofab Cobra (Rifle), Ofab Shark (Assault Rifle) and Ofab Silverback (Shotgun). The clumps drop from the bosses in Lost Eden Alien Mothership missions (taken from the Unicorn Recruiter at the Unicorn Outpost in the Outerzones, via ICC) and from the Dreadloch bosses at the Clan and Omni camps. No VP price list is published; the only figure found is a player report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol. NOTE: ao-universe lists Type 812 as covering Bow; wiki.aodb.us lists it as Crossbow. Unresolved - both recorded in _unverified.

weapons.name: Dreadloch Rapier
weapons.source: Dreadloch camps (Lost Eden), level 210-220. Dreadloch weapons are a DIRECT DROP from the Dreadloch camp bosses, not a tradeskill. They are QL300 only and require the Lost Eden expansion to wield (from the item's own Expansion(389) criterion). There are two sets of five camps, one per side. Omni-side camps (the CLAN quest chain, started by Captain Cante Hawke in Old Athens): Clondyke - Force Recon Commander 191; Eastern Foul Plains - Special Agent Moxy; Pleasant Meadows - Major Woon; Southern Artery Valley - Assault Commander Pax; Upper Stret East Bank - Peal Thunder. Clan-side camps (the OMNI quest chain, started by Paolo Turin near the Grid terminal in Omni-1 Trade 409x542, who sends you to Sergeant Jasmine Cordell in Omni-1 Entertainment 906x629): Belial Forest 3184x503 - Brigadier Crux; Athen Shire / War Academy 1720x1920 - Assault Commander Sleek; The Longest Road / Drumdar 3650x574 - Chief Gunner Kyle Swan; Broken Shores 2240x4765 - Special Agent Deko; Upper Stret East Bank / Safe Haventown 1798.6x2207.0 - Carillion Thunder. The bosses have a 2-hour respawn and the corpse can be looted for 29 minutes before it rots. The quest is NOT required to claim the loot - completing it adds a merit token worth +50 side tokens and +500 Victory Points. The same bosses also drop high-quality Kyr'Ozch clumps for Ofab upgrades, Hellfyre Magma Suit armour, the merit/combat board bases and the Dreadloch utility items (Damage Amplifier, Endurance Booster, Sniper's Friend, Stab Guidance System, Survival Predictor). No per-weapon drop rate is published on either allowed source. NOTE: Dreadloch weapons are NODROP. Which boss drops which weapon is not published: both guides list the weapon set per camp-chain, not per boss.

weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Energy Pistol - Type 5
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump). Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets. Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n>. The Structural Analyzer is either Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool (reusable) + Kyr'Ozch Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool (consumed; a common Hacker'Uri drop) at 600 Quantum FT, or the reward for Uncle Bazzit's AI Perk 3 quest. Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared. Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published. Type -> specials: 1 Fling Shot; 2 Aimed Shot; 3 Fling+Aimed; 4 Burst; 5 Fling+Burst; 12 Burst+Full Auto; 13 Fling+Burst+Full Auto; 48 Brawl+Dimach; 76 Brawl+Fast Attack; 112 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack; 240 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack; 880 Dimach+Fast Attack+Parry+Riposte; 992 Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack+Parry+Riposte.

weapons.name: Dawn of the Xan
weapons.source: Legacy of the Xan team instances (device) + Pandemonium (base weapon). Xan Weapon Upgrade Device + <base weapon QL 299/300> = <X> of the Xan. No tradeskill skill required. The Xan Weapon Upgrade Device is QL 300, NODROP/Unique and is consumed by the combine. It drops in the three Legacy of the Xan team instances entered from floor portals in the Central Hub playfield: The Alien Threat / 'Mitaar Hero' (portal at 350 x 410, boss Technomaster Sinuh), LoX: Ground Chief Vortexx (portal at 523 x 307), and The Xan 12-man (portal at 419 x 324, final boss Deranged Xan). Since patch 18.3 none of them need the old prerequisite quests. No drop rate is published. The combine itself needs NO tradeskill skill. Base weapon for most sins is the matching Lord/Lady of <sin> from The Beast in Pandemonium. Dawn of the Xan and Dusk of the Xan take Sword of Dawn / Sword of Dusk instead (see those entries). Angst of the Xan additionally accepts High Lord of Angst; Anger/Envy/Angst of the Xan additionally accept the matching Superior Rebuilt Perennium weapon.

weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership. An untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon has no special attacks until it is typed with a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> clump (see the '- Type' entries). weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Energy Hammer - Type 112
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump). Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets. Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n>. The Structural Analyzer is either Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool (reusable) + Kyr'Ozch Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool (consumed; a common Hacker'Uri drop) at 600 Quantum FT, or the reward for Uncle Bazzit's AI Perk 3 quest. Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared. Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published. Type -> specials: 1 Fling Shot; 2 Aimed Shot; 3 Fling+Aimed; 4 Burst; 5 Fling+Burst; 12 Burst+Full Auto; 13 Fling+Burst+Full Auto; 48 Brawl+Dimach; 76 Brawl+Fast Attack; 112 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack; 240 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack; 880 Dimach+Fast Attack+Parry+Riposte; 992 Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack+Parry+Riposte.

weapons.name: Sword of Dawn
weapons.source: Pandemonium (Shadowlands). Notum Seed + Sunrise Hilt = Sword of Dawn  (Clan/Redeemed side) Novictum Seed + Sunset Hilt = Sword of Dusk  (Omni/Unredeemed side) Requires 500 Weapon Smithing - the only step in the whole Xan line with a real skill requirement. Notum Seed drops from The Night Heart on the Redeemed (Clan) side of Pandemonium; Novictum Seed from The Night Heart on the Unredeemed (Omni) side. Neither is a 100% drop; both also turn up in player shops. Sunrise Hilt (Clan) and Sunset Hilt (Omni) are 100% NODROP drops from The Beast. Recorded rates over 104 kills: Sunrise 18.27%, Sunset 4.81%. Neutrals capped at 25,000 faction cannot obtain these. NOTE: Feeds Dawn of the Xan / Dusk of the Xan.

criteria.summary: Picks are computed from the items' OWN stats in items.ocp plus this profession's skill cost factors. They are NOT a community tier list and are not presented as one.
criteria.dpsProxy: avgDamage / (attackDelaySec + rechargeDelaySec), where avgDamage = (MinDamage+MaxDamage)/2 and the two delays are the item's AttackDelay (stat 294) and RechargeDelay (stat 210) in 1/100 s. This is a COMPARISON PROXY ONLY: it ignores initiative caps, crit rate, add-damage, damage modifiers, nano buffs and special attacks, so it ranks these weapons against each other on the item data - it is not in-game DPS.
criteria.ipWeightedReq: Sum over every ToWield skill and special-attack requirement of (requiredValue x this profession's cost factor for that skill, from reference/skillcaps.json). Lower means cheaper for this profession to actually reach. It is a relative IP-burden number, not an IP total.
criteria.topDamage: The model with the highest dpsProxy in the skill. Reported with its gates (expansion, title level) so an unreachable pick is obvious.
criteria.bestValue: Among models that still reach at least 60% of that skill's top dpsProxy - i.e. among weapons that are actually competitive - the one with the highest dpsProxy / ipWeightedReq. The 60% floor is there because without it the metric just picks the weakest, cheapest weapon in the skill; it is a stated threshold, not a fact.
criteria.bestWithoutExpansion: The highest dpsProxy model whose ToWield carries NO Expansion(389) gate - i.e. the best option for a character without the expansions. Null if every endgame model in that skill is expansion-gated.
criteria.gates: expansion = the ToWield Expansion(389) BitAnd criterion, authoritative. titleLevelReq = the ToWield TitleLevel(37) criterion: 6 = level 190+, 7 = level 205+.
criteria.caveat: Where two models tie on dpsProxy the one with the lower ipWeightedReq is listed first. 'Best' here means best on these stated measures and nothing more.

The Corrupted weapons are a parallel endgame drop line, added in patch 18.8.6 (27 Oct 2015). They drop from the bosses of Pyramid of Home, a 6-man level 201-220 dungeon: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, then Phobettor. Portals last 4 hours (18.8.7). Patch 18.8.8 (9 Nov 2015) confirms what these are: the duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry was renamed and modified into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, and the Achaean Conqueror was added to drop alongside the other Corrupted weapons. xanWalkthrough.summary: The 'Xan' weapons are NOT a drop. Every one of them starts as a Shadowlands Beast weapon (or a Sword of Dawn/Dusk), which is then upgraded with a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device that drops in the Legacy of the Xan team instances. The combine needs no tradeskill skill.
expansionsNeeded: Shadowlands - for Pandemonium, where the starting weapon drops.
Legacy of the Xan booster - for the Central Hub instances the upgrade device drops in, AND to wield the finished weapon (the item's own Expansion(389) criterion carries bit 7 = LegacyOfTheXan).
Alien Invasion - only for the optional High Lord of Angst side-step.
xanWalkthrough.levelBand: Content level 201-220. The finished 'X of the Xan' weapons require title level 6 (level 190+) in their own ToWield criteria; the 'Corrupted Lord of X' versions require title level 7 (level 205+).

steps.what: Get the starting piece: a Beast weapon.
steps.detail: Kill The Beast, the final boss of the Pandemonium playfield (Shadowlands). Pandemonium is reached by killing the portal bosses that open the blue portal onward; an instanced version exists via an altar just inside the zone. The Night Heart is the mid-boss. The Beast respawns on a 9-hour timer.
steps.drops: The Beast drops the weapon as 'Lord of <Sin>' (QL 300) or 'Lady of <Sin>' (QL 299) - identical items otherwise. Over 104 documented kills The Beast dropped 2-4 weapons, 4 armour pieces, both hilts, 1-2 profession stars and one Shadowbreed per kill. No per-weapon drop rate is published.
steps.whichOne: Pick the sin that matches the weapon skill you want. Read from the client data (each Lord/Lady template's own primary wield skill in items.ocp): Abandonment = 1h Blunt, Anger = Assault Rifle, Angst = Rifle, Chaos = Bow, Deceit = Piercing, Envy = MG/SMG, Gluttony = 2h Blunt, Greed = Shotgun, Hatred = 1h Edged, Lust = Pistol, Pride = 2h Edged, Sloth = Grenade, Wisdom = Martial Arts. For Bureaucrat the usable starting pieces are: Lord/Lady of Abandonment (1h Blunt) -> Abandonment of the Xan; Lord/Lady of Envy (MG/SMG) -> Envy of the Xan; Lord/Lady of Greed (Shotgun) -> Greed of the Xan; Lord/Lady of Lust (Pistol) -> Lust of the Xan; Lord/Lady of Wisdom (Martial Arts) -> Wisdom of the Xan. There is NO Lord/Lady of <sin> weapon, and therefore no Xan weapon, for these skills on this profession's list: Ranged Energy, Melee Energy.

steps.what: Melee Energy only: build a Sword of Dawn or Sword of Dusk instead.
steps.detail: There is no 'Lord of' weapon for Melee Energy. Clan/Redeemed: Notum Seed + Sunrise Hilt = Sword of Dawn. Omni/Unredeemed: Novictum Seed + Sunset Hilt = Sword of Dusk. This step needs 500 Weapon Smithing - the only real skill requirement in the whole line.
steps.drops: Notum Seed / Novictum Seed drop from The Night Heart in Pandemonium (Redeemed and Unredeemed side respectively); not 100%, and both also appear in player shops. Sunrise Hilt (Clan) and Sunset Hilt (Omni) are 100% NODROP drops from The Beast - recorded at 18.27% and 4.81% over 104 kills. Neutrals capped at 25,000 faction cannot get these.
steps.whichOne: Sword of Dawn -> Dawn of the Xan; Sword of Dusk -> Dusk of the Xan.

steps.what: Get a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device.
steps.detail: The Xan Weapon Upgrade Device is QL 300, NODROP/Unique and is consumed by the combine. It drops in the three Legacy of the Xan team instances entered from floor portals in the Central Hub playfield: The Alien Threat / 'Mitaar Hero' (portal at 350 x 410, boss Technomaster Sinuh), LoX: Ground Chief Vortexx (portal at 523 x 307), and The Xan 12-man (portal at 419 x 324, final boss Deranged Xan). Since patch 18.3 none of them need the old prerequisite quests. No drop rate is published. The combine itself needs NO tradeskill skill.
steps.drops: Drops in all three Legacy of the Xan team instances. No drop rate is published on either allowed source.
steps.whichOne: One device per weapon; it is consumed by the combine.

steps.what: Combine: Xan Weapon Upgrade Device + base weapon = <Sin> of the Xan.
steps.detail: Done in the tradeskill window (Shift+T). NO tradeskill skill is required. The base weapon must be QL 299 or 300.
steps.whichOne: Each Lord/Lady of <sin> becomes '<sin> of the Xan'; Sword of Dawn -> Dawn of the Xan and Sword of Dusk -> Dusk of the Xan. Relevant to Bureaucrat: Lord/Lady of Abandonment -> Abandonment of the Xan (1h Blunt); Lord/Lady of Envy -> Envy of the Xan (MG/SMG); Lord/Lady of Greed -> Greed of the Xan (Shotgun); Lord/Lady of Lust -> Lust of the Xan (Pistol); Lord/Lady of Wisdom -> Wisdom of the Xan (Martial Arts). (For skills this profession does not use: Anger, Angst, Chaos, Deceit, Gluttony, Hatred, Pride, Sloth; Lord/Lady of Wisdom -> Kuma Tonfa.) Angst additionally accepts High Lord of Angst; Anger/Envy/Angst additionally accept the matching Superior Rebuilt Perennium weapon.

steps.what: Optional final tier: Modified Xan Weapons.
steps.detail: A finished 'X of the Xan' plus one shop-bought component, QL 150 or higher, consumed. No tradeskill skill required.
steps.whichOne: Gluttony of the Xan + Notum Enriched Nano Paste - 16x Layer = Bhan'Zor Hammer (2h Blunt). Abandonment of the Xan + Notum Enriched Nano Paste - 16x Layer = Kur'Ush Mallet (1h Blunt). Lust of the Xan + Nano Pylon = Peh'Wer Pistol, then Peh'Wer Pistol + Runtime Critical Area Analyzer = Troa'Ler Pistol. (Envy -> Rhat'Ata Gun and Angst -> Gan'Kar Rifle are MG/SMG and Rifle.) There is no documented modified version for Chaos, Pride, Hatred, Dawn or Dusk.

parallelLine.what: The 'Corrupted Lord of <Sin>' weapons (ids 302933-302949) are NOT a step in this chain. They are a separate, parallel endgame line that DROPS from the Pyramid of Home 6-man dungeon (level 201-220), added in patch 18.8.6.
parallelLine.why: Patch 18.8.8 renamed a duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, which is why the two sets share flavour text in the client data. The Corrupted versions require title level 7 (level 205+) where the 'of the Xan' versions require title level 6 (level 190+), and their damage figures differ.
parallelLine.howToGet: Pyramid of Home ('Dark Pyramid Below'): enter through the large door behind Number Nine in the Temple of Home, Broken Shores (the dungeon sits in the crater north of the city of Home). Access needs a Profession Nanodeck worn, or 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. Bosses: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, Phobettor. No drop rates published.

openQuestions: No drop rate is published for the Xan Weapon Upgrade Device, for individual Lord/Lady of X weapons, or for anything in Pyramid of Home.

The client data contains 'Mirror of the Xan' (ids 273645-273680, 302628/302629/302745/302808) and 'Shattered Mirror of the Xan' (302810). Searches of wiki.aodb.us and ao-universe return nothing for either name, so their role is UNKNOWN. They are not weapons (no hand slot) and are not recorded here as a chain component.
A claim that Corrupted weapons can be upgraded with a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device exists online but only on a source outside the allowed list; it is not recorded as fact.

Modified Xan Weapons exist only for Gluttony, Abandonment, Envy, Lust (-> Peh'Wer -> Troa'Ler) and Angst. There is no modified version for Chaos, Pride, Hatred, Deceit, Anger, Greed, Sloth, Dawn, Dusk or Kuma Tonfa - that gap is real, not a research miss.

Per wiki.aodb.us, Modified Xan Weapons were froob-friendly from patch 18.1 until 18.6.17 and are not any more - so the expansion gate recorded here reflects the current client, not their whole history.

acquisitionGaps: No published drop rate for the Xan Weapon Upgrade Device, for individual Lord/Lady of X weapons, for Solid Clumps of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material, or for Sector 7 Special Edition weapons. The Beast's hilts and stars are the only rated drops found.
Untyped Kyr'Ozch weapons: no per-mob or per-playfield table exists on the allowed sources; only 'the city raid boss and the boss on the alien ship'.
Ofab: no Victory Point price list published. The only figure found is a player forum report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol - recorded here as a player report, not as fact.
Ofab Type 812: ao-universe says it covers Bow, wiki.aodb.us says Crossbow. Unresolved; both recorded.
Perennium rebuild-kit quest name differs between sources ('Yutto's Spirit quest' vs 'Joining the hunt'). Unresolved.
Rows whose acquisition.how is 'unknown' carry no drop mob or playfield. The per-item drop databases (auno.org, aoitems.com) are blocked to automation, so nothing was approximated from them.
rankingIsNotFact: dpsProxy is a comparison number computed from the item's own damage and delay stats. It is not in-game DPS: it ignores initiative caps, crit rate, add-damage, damage modifiers, buffs and special attacks.
ipWeightedReq is a relative burden number from skillcaps.json cost factors, not an IP total.
No community tier list or player consensus is asserted anywhere in this file. Where a 'best' is named it is best on the stated measure only.
rulesThatAreJudgementCalls: The 'top QL >= 200 AND max damage >= 300' endgame floor for the 'expansion' and 'high-rk' tiers is a threshold chosen here, not a fact from the client data. The TL6/TL7 tiers are authoritative (read from the item's TitleLevel criterion).
The list of weapon skills this profession uses is operator-supplied (see the -WeaponSkills parameter). The client data does not encode 'profession X uses weapon skill Y'.

_deviations: 474 endgame models against the Soldier's 623 and the Doctor's 597, and the shape is lopsided: Pistol 128, 1h Blunt 94, MG-SMG 74, Shotgun 74, Ranged Energy 56, Martial Arts 30, Melee Energy 18. Only the Pistol column is a real endgame choice for a Crat; the rest are recorded because the class CAN wield them, at 3.2-4.0 IP.

THE XAN LINE IS REACHABLE FOR FIVE OF THE SEVEN SKILLS AND NOT FOR RANGED ENERGY. Every Xan weapon starts as a Beast weapon named for a sin, and the sin fixes the skill. Of the Crat's seven skills the Beast supplies Lust (Pistol), Abandonment (1h Blunt), Envy (MG-SMG), Greed (Shotgun) and Wisdom (Martial Arts). Melee Energy has no sin weapon but has its own route - Sword of Dawn / Sword of Dusk, the only step in the whole line that needs a tradeskill (500 Weapon Smithing). RANGED ENERGY HAS NEITHER: a Bureaucrat wielding Ranged Energy has no Xan endgame at all.

'Lust of the Xan' is the Bureaucrat's headline weapon and its starting piece is not farmable on demand: Lord/Lady of Lust drops from The Beast in Pandemonium on a 9-hour respawn, and the upgrade device drops in the three Legacy-of-the-Xan Central Hub instances. Both halves are raid content, so the realistic solo-Crat endgame pistol is the Ofab or Dreadloch line, not Xan.

9 templates were EXCLUDED and each says why in _unverified.excludedModels: 4 GM/test templates whose skill requirement never scaled with QL (206720, 206722, 206723, 258345), 3 generic NPC weapons that top out at QL400 when no player item exceeds QL300 (43074, 44007, 45605), 1 player-unreachable template (295603, 2500 max damage at a skill requirement of 49999) and 1 template with no row in itemnames.sql (305998) whose name therefore could not be verified.

Source coverage is 88 of 474 models (19%), in line with the Soldier (102 of 623) and the Doctor (89 of 597). The gap is the same one every class hits: local data has the item, the drop database that has the mob is blocked to automation, so the row says unknown instead of guessing.
